description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of TARG and PERMUTE by language family on the performance of mBERT and XLM models. The horizontal axis represents the language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis measures the effect, with values ranging from 0 to 40. The chart includes four sets of bars for each language family, each representing a different model or condition: mBERT-targ, XLM-targ, mBERT-permute, and XLM-permute. The bars are color-coded, with mBERT-targ in light blue, XLM-targ in dark blue, mBERT-permute in green, and XLM-permute in yellow. The bars vary in height, indicating the effect size, with error bars showing the standard deviation. The chart does not include any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
